269: People who have gained the power that comes from strict self-control can even escape death itself.
270: Many people in the world have nothing because only a few practice strict self-control, while most do not.
271: When someone with a cheating mind pretends to live a holy life, the five elements (earth, water, fire, air and sky) that make up their own body laugh at them from inside.
278: Many people with dirty minds bathe in holy waters, just like truly great people do, and hide their bad lives behind that show.
281: If you never want to be looked down on, guard your heart so it never even thinks of stealing anything from anyone, however small.
284: A strong desire to gain by cheating will, in the end, bring sorrow that never ends.
285: People who want others' things and wait for the moment someone is not paying attention cannot have love or truly care about kindness.
286: People with a deep, fixed love of cheating cannot keep their actions within proper limits.
290: People who cheat will lose even the life in their own body. People who never cheat will not miss out even on the world of the gods.
303: Forget your anger toward anyone at all, because every kind of harm grows out of anger.
351: Thinking that things which are not real are real is a mistake of the mind. From this mistake come unhappy births, again and again.
352: For people who are free from confusion and see the truth clearly, that clear sight drives away darkness and brings true joy.
356: People who have learned and seen what is truly real, here in this life, take the path that never leads back to this world. They are never born here again.
358: True wisdom is seeing the perfect truth, the highest good, so that the foolishness that causes us to be born again and again is taken away.
359: Whoever understands what truly supports all things, and lives so that all other attachments fall away, will never be touched by the sorrows that would otherwise cling to them.
395: People who learn by standing humbly before their teachers, like the poor before the rich, are truly great. Those who refuse to learn are the lowest of all.
